# BenihKode — Seed of Code

> BenihKode is a solo, multi-practice developer studio. The site is the public face: a development journal, a shipped-work portfolio, lightweight product PRDs ("ideas"), and in-browser tools. Where ideas are planted, code is cultivated, and growth is documented.

BenihKode builds small, opinionated developer tools and ships them — CLIs, npm packages, Flutter/Godot apps, and browser tools — then writes honestly about the engineering behind them. The work spans four practices: mobile-app redesign, Apify actors, WordPress plugins, and standalone dev tools.

## Shipped tools & apps (selected)

- [gitcommitgen](https://benihkode.web.id/tools/gitcommitgen/) — AI-powered conventional commit messages from staged changes
- [gitprgen](https://benihkode.web.id/tools/gitprgen/) — AI-powered PR description generator
- [gitprune](https://benihkode.web.id/tools/gitprune/) — safe git branch cleanup
- [secretsweep](https://benihkode.web.id/tools/secretsweep/) — zero-config secret scanning for staged files
- [jsonask](https://benihkode.web.id/tools/jsonask/) — query JSON in natural language instead of jq
- [envtainer](https://benihkode.web.id/tools/envtainer/) — environment-variable management for .env files
- [mcpkit](https://benihkode.web.id/tools/mcpkit/) — generate MCP servers from OpenAPI specs, DBs, or YAML
- [changelog-ai](https://benihkode.web.id/tools/changelog-ai/) — zero-config AI changelog generator from git history
- [DomainForge](https://benihkode.web.id/projects/domainforge/) — crawl websites directly into clean, RAG-ready datasets
- [Gas Flow Calculator](https://benihkode.web.id/projects/gas-flow-calculator/) — field-ready Flutter ISO 5167 utility
- [Solstice Cipher](https://benihkode.web.id/projects/solstice-cipher/) — free offline Android puzzle game (Godot 4)
- [PocketBudget](https://benihkode.web.id/projects/pocketbudget/) — local-first personal finance tracker
